label: Слово
description: Twelve-mission case drill for слово (word) — all six cases, singular and plural.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative singular. The dictionary form слово stands as the subject after Это. Neuter nouns in -о take a bare nominative, and for inanimate neuters this form also serves as the accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive singular. The nominative слово shifts to слова. The verb знать under negation takes the genitive; neuter -о nouns end in -а with stem stress preserved.
Strategic focus: Dative singular. Слово takes the dative ending слову. The verb учить (teach) governs the dative of the thing taught; neuter and masculine nouns share this -у ending.
Strategic focus: Accusative singular. The direct object of скажи is слово, identical to the nominative. For inanimate neuter nouns the accusative always matches the nominative.
Strategic focus: Instrumental singular. The nominative слово becomes словом. The instrumental marks the means with which the speech began, taking the ending -ом.
Strategic focus: Prepositional singular. Слово changes to слове after в. The prepositional, here marking the locus of difficulty, never appears without a preposition; neuter -о nouns take -е.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. The plural subject is слова. Neuter nouns form the nominative plural in -а, shifting the stress onto the ending.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural. The form слов is the bare stem with a zero ending. Negation нет triggers the genitive; neuter -о nouns typically drop the ending in the genitive plural.
Strategic focus: Dative plural. Слова becomes словам. The verb верить governs the dative of what one trusts; -ам is the dative plural ending shared by all genders.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural. The direct object слова matches the nominative plural. Since слово is inanimate, the accusative plural equals the nominative plural.
Strategic focus: Instrumental plural. The plural слова takes the ending словами. The instrumental marks the means of persuasion; -ами is the universal instrumental plural ending.
Strategic focus: Prepositional plural. Слова shifts to словах after в. The prepositional plural ending -ах applies across all genders and always requires a preposition.
